company.name: Saudi Aramco
company.shortDescription: Saudi Aramco is a state-owned oil company focused on energy and gas production.
company.description:
The Saudi Arabian Oil Company (Saudi Aramco) is the state-owned oil company of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. It ranks first among oil companies worldwide in terms of crude oil production and exports, and natural gas liquids (NGL) exports, and is among the leading producers of natural gas. It is also known as refiners and are moving further downstream into chemicals production.

The company was founded in 1930 and is headquartered in Dhahran, Saudi Arabia.

aiResearchSummary.text: Saudi Aramco is researching and developing technologies for oil and gas production, including methods for improving oil and gas well productivity, multi-stage sweeping gas membrane distillation systems, integrated flare systems for gas plants, removal of crude oil from water in gas oil separation plants, and estimating molecular weight of hydrocarbons. Additional focus areas include facies clustering for subterranean property modeling, downhole vibration tools, and enhanced hydroprocessing processes with ammonia and carbon dioxide recovery, reflecting a broad approach to energy and gas innovation.
